title: AMASS research benchmark corpus
description: Ground-truth definitions for vulnerable applications used to evaluate the AMASS pipeline. Each app entry describes how to provision it and the vulnerabilities a correct pipeline should find.

id.description: Stable machine id (used as the Scan name suffix and in reports).

repoUrl.description: Git clone URL; also the join key to ScanRepository.url.

ref.description: Commit/branch to pin for reproducible runs.

strategy.description: repo-dockerfile = Mode 1 (build the repo's Dockerfile); generated-* = Mode 2 template.

port.description: Port the app listens on (health check target).

startCommand.description: Explicit argv when the repo Dockerfile declares no CMD (e.g. NodeGoat: npm start).

env.description: Allowlisted env needed to run the app (e.g. MONGODB_URI).

siblingContainers.description: Infrastructure the app needs on the same internal network (e.g. a database).

expectedSurface.description: Route map Scout should discover (recall numerator for recon completeness). Path templates with :params allowed.

id.description: Stable finding id within the app.

vulnerabilityType.description: Canonical type used by the pipeline (e.g. SQL_INJECTION) — matches Exploit.vulnerabilityType.

scope.description: sniper = current Sniper verifiers must CONFIRM it (counts in precision/recall); static = the static scanner must surface it at DETECTED level; future = known vuln not yet verifiable by this pipeline (reported separately, excluded from scoring).

filePath.description: Source file hint for static-level correlation.

routes.description: HTTP surface where the vulnerability is reachable. Templates (:param) supported.

path.description: Path template, e.g. /memos/:id or /search (query params not included).

parameter.description: Injection parameter when the finding is parameter-level.
